title: Book Three · Chapter 21: The Page She Keeps
story:
During the following week, Anna brings her maths book to lunch again.

There is a piece of blue paper near the back. Ronan has seen it move through the book over the last few weeks.

“Nearly finished?” he asks.

“Not with all of it. Just this part.”

She opens the book to a page of shapes. Her friend comes to the desk with a ruler.

“Did you find the line?” the girl asks.

“I think so.”

Anna turns her notebook toward her. Ronan can see a large triangle and two shorter lines inside it.

The girls look from the notebook to the book. Anna points to one corner.

“This line starts here.”

Her friend puts the ruler against the drawing.

“Yes. Mine starts too far down.”

Ronan opens his lunch. He eats for a while, then looks outside. The grass is dry today.

“Are you running?” he asks Anna.

“Not today. We want to finish this page.”

“No running at all?”

“On Friday. We ran yesterday too.”

She turns back to the drawing. Her friend moves a chair closer.

Kai comes past with his lunch box.

“Outside?” he asks Ronan.

Ronan closes his empty box and stands up. Anna lifts a hand. She keeps her eyes on the page.

In the yard, Kai's friend is leaning against the wall. His shoe is untied, but he does not seem to notice.

“Your foot will escape,” Ronan tells him.

The boy looks down. He pulls the lace tight and ties it.

They sit on the low steps. Kai has one orange. He presses his thumb into the skin and opens it.

“Do you want some?”

Ronan takes two pieces. The sharp smell stays on his fingers.

Kai's friend tells them about a dog near his home. It carried a child's shoe into a shop. The child followed with one bare foot.

“Did he get it back?” Ronan asks.

“Yes. The shopkeeper gave the dog some food.”

Kai looks at his orange.

“The dog got lunch.”

“And the boy got his shoe,” Ronan says.

They laugh. After a while, the bell rings.

Back upstairs, Anna is putting her things away. The blue paper has moved to the next page.

“Finished?” Ronan asks.

“That page. We found the last line.”

Her friend takes her ruler and goes back to her own desk.

Ronan sits down. Anna looks at his hands.

“Orange?”

“Kai's. Can you smell it?”

“From here.”

He holds his fingers away from her book. She closes the cover and moves it onto her own half of the desk.

“I want to keep this page clean.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

triangle＝三角形；lean against＝靠着；bare foot＝光着的一只脚；shopkeeper＝店主。

## 理解问题

1. Anna为什么这天不去跑步？她是否已经不再练跑步？
2. Ronan午间和谁一起待在外面？回教室时，Anna的数学题有什么进展？

## 读句子

**The blue paper has moved to the next page.**

拆开看：The blue paper / has moved / to the next page.

那张蓝纸／已经移了位置／移到了下一页。
